description: Invoice arithmetic audit: line extensions, discounts, supplied tax, totals, with the drift in minor units — Recomputes up to 500 invoice lines in exact decimal arithmetic and compares them with the stated amounts, for an agent about to approve, pay or reconcile an invoice. Checks: quantity x unit price less discount equals the line amount; tax is taken as supplied (tax amounts are summed, never looked up) and, where a rate is given, tax equals rate x line amount under the declared rounding scope (per li

amount.description: Stated net line amount after the line discount.

discount.description: Line discount as a positive amount in major units.

quantity.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

taxAmount.description: Tax on this line as supplied.

taxRate.description: Tax rate in percent, e.g. "7.5". With taxAmount it is checked. A non-zero rate without taxAmount cannot be checked: the result is unknown, and no tax is inferred.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit in major units; sub-cent precision allowed.

rounding.description: Default half-up. half-up: ties away from zero. half-down: ties toward zero. half-even: ties to the even neighbour. up: away from zero. down: toward zero. ceiling: toward +infinity. floor: toward -infinity.

subtotal.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

taxTotal.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

total.description: Grand total; checked against subtotal + taxTotal.

taxRounding.description: line (default): each line's tax is rounded on its own. invoice: tax is rounded once per distinct rate on the sum of the line amounts, and compared with the supplied tax sum for that rate.

toleranceMinor.description: Largest absolute drift in minor units still treated as a match. Default 0.

name: invoice-audit
